openRole.teachingRole: Choose an independently captured 2D opener with visible crossing or motion-per-tick evidence. Record platform screen dimensions independently and show equal pixel increments in the authored test, never as commercial engine telemetry.

clipWindows: Madeline jumps between snow-covered platforms and climbs when in reach of a wall; the game displays its climb prompt.
The bridge collapses under Madeline, she jumps from breaking sections and dashes toward the ledge.
Madeline responds to the side of a platform and a narrow hazard approach in the first chapter.

celeste.evidence: Blue dash trail covers several short platform spans in one fixed-screen room. The authored board, rather than the retail footage, tests identical pixels-per-frame increments.

displayUnits.basis: The local NTSC Kirby Air Ride HUD displays mph. Real-world speeds are never inferred from the game readout or our monitor render.
displayUnits.rule: Distance per render frame is distinguished from distance per simulation tick and distance per elapsed second.
